text:
Sam: Hey team, planning note — Q2 run-rate for Dedicated pools is trending up. Need to open quota increases for GPUs, ENIs, and external IPs in us-west1 and eu-west3. Draft below, please review.
Maya: +1, been watching the forecast. Can you paste the target numbers?
Sam: Sure — rough ask: reserve 40 A100s (40*80GB), 20 H100s in us-west1; eu-west3 we want 20 A100s + 10 H100s. Also need ENI quota bump: +200 per region, and external IPv4 (EIP) pool +120 for burst.
Raj: FYI our current vCPU quota in us-west1 will also block autoscaling if we attach more nodes. Need +3200 vCPUs in us-west1 and +1600 in eu-west3.
Ella: Running cost calc: reserving 40 A100s monthly vs burst: reserving saves ~35% on committed pricing but increases committed spend by ~$90k/mo. If we go partial reserve (20 reserved + 20 burst) we get 18% savings and keep flexibility.
Sam: Good call. Proposal: reserve 50% of projected steady-state per region, leave the rest as burstable on demand. I'll put numbers in the ticket.
Kofi: infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-1427 and cloud case CC-987654321 with provider. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INFRA-1427
Maya: For the cloud case, include this gcloud snippet to validate current quotas for team reviewers:
```
# list accelerator quotas
gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --format="flattened(quotas)"
```
Raj: Also include network limits: subnet secondary IP ranges per node group will hit /24 limits if we spin many small VMs. Request expanding subnet allocation to /20 or add extra secondary ranges. Put that in the ticket.
Ella: On EIP strategy: prefer ephemeral pools for burst and reserved static addresses for Dedicated frontends. Suggest we request 80 ephemeral + 40 static per region. That keeps NAT/egress predictable.
Sam: I'll draft the cloud support message. Thoughts on rollback/fallback if provider denies quotas?
Maya: Fallback plan: (1) shift some capacity to eu-central1 for non-sensitive workloads, (2) reduce per-request max_tokens / batch sizes to free up concurrent slots, and (3) spin up lower-capacity quantized instances (T4/GPU small) as stopgap.
Raj: We should also ask for higher ephemeral port ranges on the firewall — current ephemeral ports saturated when we run heavy KV cache warmups. Add egress rule limit bump.
Kofi: infra-bot: updated INFRA-1427 with cost estimates and fallback steps. Assigned to Raj + Ella for cloud quota payload.
Sam: Thanks — Raj/Ella, can you finalize the payload today? I want support case out before EOD PST. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ella: On it. Will attach subnet diagrams and ASN for dedicated VPC.
Maya: I'll run a quick forecast with the latest telemetry and add a 95th percentile headroom number. Expect a follow-up in ~2 hours. :bar_chart:
Raj: If cloud needs justification numbers, call out sustained token/sec rates: current prod 2.2M tokens/sec, projected ramp to 6.5M tokens/sec with new customers — hence the GPU/tPU need.
Sam: Great. Once cloud replies, we'll post updates here. Thanks all. :rocket:
infra-bot: Scheduled reminder set: ping INFRA-1427 assignees in 24h.
